mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ve.debit_amount), 0) AS totalDebit, IFNULL(SUM(ve.credit_amount), 0) AS totalCredit FROM fin_voucher_entry ve LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON ve.voucher_id = v.id LEFT JOIN fin_subject s ON ve.subject_id = s.id WHERE v.period_code = #{periodCode} AND s.subject_code LIKE '2221%' AND v.status != '3'

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ve.debit_amount), 0) AS totalDebit, IFNULL(SUM(ve.credit_amount), 0) AS totalCredit FROM fin_voucher_entry ve LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON ve.voucher_id = v.id LEFT JOIN fin_subject s ON ve.subject_id = s.id WHERE v.period_code = #{periodCode} AND s.subject_code LIKE '2221%' AND v.status != '3'

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ve.credit_amount) - SUM(ve.debit_amount), 0) FROM fin_voucher_entry ve LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON ve.voucher_id = v.id LEFT JOIN fin_subject s ON ve.subject_id = s.id WHERE v.period_code = #{periodCode} AND s.subject_type = '5' AND s.balance_direction = '1' AND v.status != '3'

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ve.debit_amount) - SUM(ve.credit_amount), 0) FROM fin_voucher_entry ve LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON ve.voucher_id = v.id LEFT JOIN fin_subject s ON ve.subject_id = s.id WHERE v.period_code = #{periodCode} AND s.subject_type = '5' AND s.balance_direction = '0' AND v.status != '3'
